cause: MachineBuilder default EnableWaitStates=false. Desktop explicitly enables wait states. CPU cycle.rs suppresses I/O/memory waits and bypasses tick_dma while flag=false, despite CoreConfig requesting refresh simulation.
supersedes: Earlier STARTLCK and IMAGELOCK validation claims about normal wait states/effective DRAM refresh are invalid. Old measurements describe wait-states-disabled execution only.
harness_fix: EnableWaitStates(true) before first CPU execution; assert getter; at first timed OUT assert both waits and ScheduleDramRefresh, record per-phase JSON; summaries reject missing or false CPU-option evidence.
regression_guard_check: Confirmed summarizer rejects previously generated captures with no CPU-options file.
descriptor_activation: COM harness infers the first visible OUT and raster end from IMGLK001 descriptor; explicit mismatches are rejected. Preroll outputs are excluded from visible-frame activation and 1600-write pass analysis.

acquisition_debug.finding: Two targeted candidate traces accepted VSYNC-low at different beam and PIT-refresh phases; bridge rephase retained that difference. These are debugging observations, not validation of a replacement.

pit_guard.negative_test: An isolated copy of the original TEST.COM replaces four entry NOPs with MOV AL,18 / OUT 41h,AL. Harness failed at the first visible OUT with left=18 right=19; no options-valid record or completed image was emitted.
